fields.statement: At 8f186a10: go test ./internal/check (new TestRun 'overlap' case: two proposed change sets set one capability's field; one warn in-flight finding naming both sets and the node, ChangeSet A, Next 'rhiza slice --change A --view what-if') passes; go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/check-overlaps (new script: two proposed sets set statement of one node; rhiza check prints ok and exactly one 'warn in-flight ... change sets X and Y both write field:statement of N' with next rhiza slice --change X --view what-if; --json ok true, no fail) passes; full go test ./... passes, so no existing script output needed updating; diff read: check.go adds model.Overlaps findings under RuleInFlight. make check's self-check fails only on stale .rhiza/rendered from prior commit c0fa1d22 (same failure at HEAD~1; leaf touches no .rhiza file).
